meanings: to put (food or drink) into something

examples.en: Pour me a little water.

tips: A wide meaning: pour (wine, water, soup, coffee), pour out dry things (flour, sugar, salt), dish up (stew, beans), fill up (fuel).
A universal verb. Сипај воду - pour the water; сипај супу из кесице - pour the dry soup out of the packet.
«Сипати гориво» means to fill up with fuel. To dish out food, «ставити» is more common: «стави ми још меса». There is a Belgrade pub called «Сипај не питај».
